name: Add cost field to analytics dashboard
description:
Here is a 5 line summary of the conversation:

1. The task involved adding `total_cxjcoins` cost display to two Vue analytics components: `DailyChart.vue` and `MetricsDashboard.vue`.
2. A `formatCoins()` method was added to both components to format coin values with a 🪙 emoji prefix and K/M abbreviations.
3. In `DailyChart.vue`, cost data was surfaced in the hover tooltip and a fuchsia cost entry was added to the chart legend.
4. In `MetricsDashboard.vue`, a new "Total Cost" KPI card was added alongside cost badges in the Model, User, and Project breakdown sections.
5. A dedicated Cost column was also added to both the Model Performance table and the Daily Breakdown table, including a footer total row.
